newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann to issue bearer bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann to issue bearer bonds.

text.p: Bertelsmann AG, the German media giant, said on Wednesday it would sign a Debt Issuance Programme for bearer bonds totalling 1.5 billion marks in London on November 15.

The company said in a statement that the issue would be drawn upon for the first time in December in connection with financing of the merger of Compagnie Luxembourgeoise de Telediffusion (CLT) and Bertelsmann's television unit Ufa Film- und Fernseh GmbH.
The programme will introduced on the Luxembourg stock exchange.

It will be arranged by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell. Merrill Lynch International is co-arranger. Other banks involved in the placement include ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, Commerzbank AG, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Lehman Brothers International, J.P. Morgan Securities Ltd. and UBS Ltd.
Issuers are Bertelsmann AG, the holding company for the Bertelsmann group and two recently-formed financing subsidiaries Bertelsmann Capital Corporation and the Bertelsmann U.S. Finance.
